evals.prompt: deploy this to cloud run. the app is a fastapi thing, see the README. i want it live.
evals.expected_output: Assesses candidacy, writes a minimal gapp.yaml (entrypoint sample_app.server:app, SAMPLE_API_KEY as a user-supplied secret, SAMPLE_DATA_DIR under the data volume path), probes the machine for gapp tools, a GCP identity, and terraform, finds none and no browser login, and produces an ordered handoff for the workstation instead of attempting gcloud login or faking a deploy.
expectations: A gapp.yaml is written with service.entrypoint set to sample_app.server:app
SAMPLE_API_KEY is declared as a secret in gapp.yaml, not with a literal value
The agent checks whether gapp admin tools, a GCP identity, and terraform are available before trying to deploy
The agent does not run gcloud auth login and does not ask the user to paste a credential into chat
The agent does not claim the service was deployed
The final message contains an ordered handoff listing gapp setup with the project id placeholder and the CI wiring steps for the other machine

evals.prompt: ok i committed my changes, deploy my latest changes to prod
evals.expected_output: Finds gapp.yaml already present, probes capabilities, discovers no GCP identity and no CI wiring here, and either dispatches CI if it exists or explains precisely which one-time step is missing and hands it off, using only commands that exist.
expectations: The agent checks for a GCP identity and the gapp tools before attempting a deploy
The agent checks whether the solution is wired for CI before concluding deploy is impossible here
Every gapp command or tool the agent names exists: gapp ci init/setup/trigger/status or the gapp_ci_* MCP tools, with no invented flags
The agent does not claim a deploy happened
The agent tells the user which exact step is missing and where to run it

evals.prompt: i want to be able to deploy this from my phone or from a cloud session later without touching my laptop every time. what do i need to set up and where do i run it?
evals.expected_output: Explains the CI path: a private CI repo, one-time ci init and ci setup that need a project-admin identity (shared WIF pool and service account per project, one workflow per solution), after which deploys happen from anywhere by dispatching the workflow. Probes this machine, finds no GCP identity, and says the one-time wiring runs on the machine where gcloud is logged in, naming the gapp ci commands or their MCP equivalents.
expectations: The answer describes CI deploys through GitHub Actions with Workload Identity Federation as the way to deploy without the laptop
The answer says CI wiring is a one-time step that needs a project-admin identity
The answer names the real CI wiring commands (gapp ci init and gapp ci setup, or their gapp_ci_* MCP equivalents) and does not invent others
The answer distinguishes what is per project (pool, service account) from what is per solution (workflow file)
The agent checks this machine for a GCP identity and gapp tools, and tells the user to run the one-time wiring on the machine that has them
